title: Contact Restrictions on Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Compliance manual section for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the restrictions a consumer may place on how, or whether, Ridgeline contacts them.

## Section text

**1. Where a restriction is recorded.** A consumer may restrict how Ridgeline contacts them. The restriction is recorded on each placed account the consumer names or, when the consumer names none, on every one of the consumer's open placed accounts. Restrictions are recorded only on accounts whose status is placed, validation period, active, arranged, dispute hold or hardship hold.

**2. Full cease.** A cease-all-communication restriction is recorded only from a request received through mail, email, online portal or fax. A request to stop all contact made by phone is recorded as a no-phone-calls restriction, and the consumer is told that a full cease must be sent in writing.

**3. Other restriction types.** The restrictions no phone calls, no workplace contact, no email, no text messages and inconvenient time may be made through any channel.

**4. Attorney representation.** An attorney-representation restriction is recorded only when the consumer gives the attorney's telephone number, stored verbatim as the restriction's reference number; after that Ridgeline communicates only with the attorney.

**5. No duplicates.** A restriction type already recorded on an account is not recorded again on that account.

**6. What a cease does not stop.** A cease does not stop Ridgeline from:
- posting payments the consumer initiates;
- running debits the consumer authorized, until the consumer revokes them;
- furnishing tradeline actions;
- mailing verification, or settlement and closure letters the consumer asked for;
- sending one notice that collection efforts are ending or that a specific remedy is being invoked.

**7. Every stage alike.** Restrictions apply equally at every stage. Email and text restrictions are recorded even at stages where Ridgeline does not use email or text messages for collection communications, so that the preference survives a stage conversion.

## Restriction types and channels

| Restriction type | Channels from which it is recorded | Extra requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Cease all communication | Mail, email, online portal, fax | none |
| No phone calls | Any | none |
| No workplace contact | Any | none |
| No email | Any | none |
| No text messages | Any | none |
| Inconvenient time | Any | none |
| Attorney representation | Any | The attorney's telephone number |

## Basis questions

**A consumer phones and says "stop contacting me entirely". What is recorded?** A no-phone-calls restriction, and the consumer is told that a full cease must be sent in writing.

**The consumer names no account. Where does the restriction go?** On every one of the consumer's open placed accounts.

**A no-email restriction is requested on a Warehouse Placement account, where email is not used for collection communications. Is it recorded?** Yes; email and text restrictions are recorded at every stage.

**A consumer who sent a written cease also asks for a paid-in-full letter. May it be mailed?** Yes; a closure letter the consumer asked for is not stopped by a cease.
